title: Methods D and E cannot be produced by the synthetic sweep; a bare reset deletes them
evidence: refit_calibration.py:581 keeps only A/B/C; backtest.py:1946 sweep grid has no D/E axis. D/E enter only via book_line_calibration.select_method_at_real_lines (:1263). _build_prop_cfg (:617) emits no mean_scale/dispersion/line_methods; calibration_loader.py:120 update replaces each prop cfg. JSON batter_hits method E dispersion 0.0.
so_what: A bare 2026-only re-sweep strips batter_hits method E and can never restore D, degrading the arsenal unless E is manually respliced and --real-lines run after.
recommendation: Use bare-sweep then --real-lines then manual E resplice as incumbent; D needs a 1.5-plus bucket at MIN_BUCKET_OBS 100 to re-enter.

title: gamecontext and platoon features have zero runtime wiring - permanently inert
evidence: Grep props.py for gamecontext/platoon is 0 matches; runtime call props.py:1247 threads only rest. prop_features.py registers gamecontext (:188) and platoon (:204) but no sweep axis (backtest.py:1980) and no writer emits their knobs.
so_what: They cannot be auto-adopted by the sweep AND would be ignored live even if a knob were written, so --feature-diag re-checks cannot pay off without code changes.
recommendation: Decide whether to add sweep/write path plus runtime threading before re-testing; otherwise skip and rely on rest/xBA which are wired.

title: Shipped batter_hits opp_defense_strength is 0.0, contradicting MEMORY.md recorded opp0.5 survivor
evidence: baseball_mlb.json batter_hits variant_label none/opp0.0 and opp_defense_strength 0.0; MEMORY.md sec 2.1b says opp0.5 shipped and survived. Commit 5c4549b bare sweep plus --real-lines plus E resplice carries opp0.0.
so_what: An opp_defense term that once cleared the gate is no longer in production - incumbent hysteresis silently dropping a validated knob during a reset-like op.
recommendation: Confirm whether batter_hits should carry opp0.5; if yes re-earn or splice it and add a regression check.

title: DEFAULT opp_defense_strength is 1.0 - a cfg missing the key silently enables full defense
evidence: props.py:217 DEFAULT_PLAYER_PROP_DEFENSE_STRENGTH 1.0; _knob (props.py:907-915) returns default only when key absent. All 5 props set it explicitly today.
so_what: A hand-edited or malformed reset JSON omitting the key would turn opponent-defense reweighting ON at full strength unintentionally.
recommendation: After any reset verify every prop carries an explicit opp_defense_strength; consider defaulting to 0.0.

title: Method E ships only on batter_hits and has degenerated to Poisson (dispersion 0.0)
evidence: JSON batter_hits dispersion 0.0 mean_scale 1.0036; PROP_NEGBIN_ELIGIBLE excludes batter_strikeouts (props.py:366). MEMORY.md negbin-diag: E gain under the 0.002 gate everywhere.
so_what: Over-dispersion is absent (disp floors at 0) so E adds no value over Poisson; Method G variance was killed pre-build for the same reason.
recommendation: Re-run --negbin-diag on 2026 data; if disp still 0.0 deprioritize E.

title: rest, def_adj, shrink_k, xBA-D and CSW are below-gate; only rest and xBA are runtime-ready
evidence: JSON rest_strength 0.0 output_def_strength 0.0 shrinkage_k 0 all props; no line_methods. rest wired props.py:1246; method D props.py:1276; PROP_XSTATS_KIND maps only batter_hits to xba (props.py:346); CSW pending raw re-pull. Sweep grid has rest/def_adj/shrink axes (backtest.py:1981).
so_what: Only rest and xBA/method D are wired and adoptable; CSW needs new data plus a refit and gamecontext/platoon need code.
recommendation: Let the sweep re-adjudicate rest/def_adj/shrink; preview xBA via --dist-diag or --real-lines --dry-run; defer CSW/gamecontext/platoon.

title: Team-market challenger and starter/lineup adjustments are disabled but untouched by a prop reset
evidence: JSON expected_runs_challenger live_markets moneyline false totals false spreads true (analysis.py:155); lineup_adjustment batter_strikeouts 0.0; starter_adjustment pitcher props 0.0 and bvp 0.0. save_calibration preserves non-props blocks.
so_what: Challenger helps spreads only; these blocks are fit by separate backtests so a prop reset neither resets nor re-earns them.
recommendation: If team markets also regressed, re-run backtest_starters/expected-runs validation separately.
